subject: MAP kickoff — evidence roster & data-handling points of contact
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Lowe <amanda.lowe@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP kickoff — evidence roster & data-handling points of contact

Hi Amanda + Acme security team,

Thanks again for the time on Friday. Per our call I wanted to kick off a short MAP focused on SOC 2 evidence and who will own each artifact so we can align evaluation timelines. Attached is an initial draft MAP (Redwood_MAP_v0.9.xlsx) and a small evidence matrix export (SOC2_evidence_matrix.csv) that maps requirements to probable owners.

Quick asks to get us moving: 
- Can you confirm your internal GRC lead (best contact for evidence requests) and a technical POC for logs/data extraction?
- Do you have any blackout dates for December where your security team is unavailable?
- Is weekly 30-min sync OK to start, or do you prefer biweekly?

Suggested internal owners (we'll iterate):
- Evidence pack & access requests: Marissa Cole (CS lead)
- Data handling & retention specifics: Rishi Malhotra (Security eng)
- Audit logistics / SLAs: Laura Bennett (Compliance)

Proposed timeline (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): confirm POCs and evidence list
- Week 1–2: exchange of evidence artifacts, access where needed
- Week 3: evaluation testing and any follow-ups
- Week 4: close decision / next steps

Please reply with your POCs and preferred cadence and we'll lock the first sync.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment stubs: Redwood_MAP_v0.9.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), SOC2_evidence_matrix.csv (text/csv)

From: Amanda Lowe <amanda.lowe@acmehealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — evidence roster & data-handling points of contact

Olga, thanks for pulling this together.

We're happy to move forward. Our primary contacts will be: 
- GRC lead: Amanda Lowe (that's me) — security@gcm.acmehealth.com (I monitor that alias)
- Technical POC (logs & extracts): Daniel Park <daniel.park@acmehealth.com> (cc'd on security alias)

Cadence: weekly 30-min sync works for us. We do have a company-wide holiday maintenance window the week of Dec 21–25; outside of that we're flexible.

I've attached our stakeholder roster (I'll share via the security alias) and highlighted two documents you'll likely request early: network diagram and retention policy. Can Rishi confirm what format/how much detail you need for log exports?

Looking forward to the first meeting — would Dec 9, 11:00 AM PT work?

—Amanda
Amanda Lowe
Head of Security & Risk | Acme Health
amanda.lowe@acmehealth.com

Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — evidence roster & data-handling points of contact

Amanda — good to meet you (virtually). Dec 9 at 11:00 AM PT works for us; I've penciled it in.

Internal note for the map: I'll own the evidence queue and coordinate access tickets. A couple quick clarifications for Daniel and the Acme security team: 
- For network diagrams: a PDF export is fine. Redactions accepted for specific IPs as needed, but we will need architecture-level details.
- For log exports: if you can provide either daily CSV slices or direct read-only S3 access that would be ideal. Rishi, can you confirm which option the Redwood evaluation tooling prefers?

Agenda proposal for the first 30-min meeting (lean):
1) Introductions + confirm POCs (5m)
2) Walk the evidence matrix and what we'll request first (10m)
3) Access plan & next steps (10m)
4) Schedule follow-ups and owners (5m)

Thanks — I'll prepare a calendar invite and attach the current MAP draft.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — evidence roster & data-handling points of contact

Thanks — looping in a few technical details from our side: 
- Preferred log exchange: read-only S3 (or equivalent cloud storage) with short-lived credentials. If S3 not possible, daily CSV slices are acceptable but will require our automation to run slower.
- Evidence format: PDF for policies, CSV for logs, and a small JSON manifest that lists timestamps and retention windows helps our ingestion.
- For network diagrams: high-level PDF is sufficient; we do not need raw configs.

I've created a lightweight evidence-owner mapping in our internal binder and linked it here: https://redwood.app/share/ACME-MAP (view-only). Laura will be slack/contact for any compliance SLA questions.

I'll be on the call Dec 9 to walk through the technical asks. If anyone needs test S3 credentials for our staging ingestion, let me know and I can provision.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
